title: J&K should tap biomass potential to reduce fossil fuel dependence: Omar Abdullah
description: Srinagar: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has urged engineers, scientists and academic institutions to harness the region’s vast biomass resources to develop cost-effective and environmentally sustainable alternatives to fossil fuels, Brighter Kashmir reported. Addressing the inaugural session of the 41st National Convention of Chemical Engineers and a national seminar on “Biomass: A Sustainable Resource [...] The post J&K should tap biomass potential to reduce fossil fuel dependence: Omar Abdullah appeared first on BioEnergy Times .
